scripts.e2e:mock: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep-invert='@Visual|@A11y'
scripts.e2e:mock:headed: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=false npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock
scripts.e2e:real: npm run clean-reports && ENV=development API_MODE=real HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-real
scripts.e2e:p0: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep=@P0
scripts.e2e:mobile: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock-mobile
scripts.e2e:cross-browser: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock-firefox --project=ui-mock-webkit
scripts.a11y: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep=@A11y
scripts.visual: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep=@Visual
scripts.visual:update: npm run clean-reports && ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep=@Visual --update-snapshots
scripts.e2e-fullregression-runner-test-headless: npm run clean-reports && BROWSER=chrome ENV=local API_MODE=mock HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=ui-mock --grep=@FullRegression
